h1: Business Registration & Licensing Support in Nepal
directAnswer: Business registration and licensing support in Nepal guides entrepreneurs and corporate entities through structural evaluation, incorporation at the Office of Company Registrar (OCR), municipal Ward business permitting, and tax registration. We help founders establish compliant corporate foundations from day one.
centerpieceSubtitle: Select your target business structure and capital scale to generate a tailored incorporation roadmap with regulatory authorities.

sections.h2: Choosing the Right Business Structure in Nepal
sections.contentHtml:
Establishing a commercial enterprise begins with selecting the legal vehicle appropriate for your capital needs, ownership structure, and liability exposure:

Private Limited (Pvt. Ltd.)

Registered under the Companies Act 2063 at OCR. Provides limited liability protection, scalable share capital, and high credibility for corporate banking and contracts.

Sole Proprietorship Firm

Registered at the local Ward Office or Department of Commerce. Simpler setup but carries unlimited personal liability for the sole owner.

Foreign Investment (FDI)

Approved under FITTA 2019 via Department of Industry (DOI) and Nepal Rastra Bank for foreign corporate entities and non-resident investors.

1

Company Name Reservation (OCR)

Submitting unique proposed corporate names via the digital portal of the Office of Company Registrar.

2

Drafting MOA & AOA

Drafting customized constitutional bylaws defining objectives, share capital, director powers, and shareholder rights.

3

Incorporation Certificate Issuance

Digital signing, officer scrutiny, registration fee payment, and receiving the official OCR Certificate of Incorporation.

4

Local Ward Office Registration

Municipal business registration within 30 days of setup under Local Government Operation Act 2074.

5

Tax Registration (PAN/VAT at IRD)

Acquiring corporate Permanent Account Number (PAN) and biometric verification at the relevant Inland Revenue Office (IRO).

faqs.question: How long does it take to register a Private Limited Company in Nepal?
faqs.answer: With prepared promoter citizenship documents, clear proposed business names, and drafted MOA/AOA, online OCR processing and certificate issuance typically completes within 5 to 9 business days.

faqs.question: What must be done within 30 days after company incorporation?
faqs.answer: Under Nepalese law, the newly registered company must register with the local Municipal Ward Office where its office is situated, obtain its PAN from the IRD, open a commercial bank account, and file share allotment records (Share Lagat) at the OCR.
